description: Creates the SparkSession with the project's Spark settings (spark.* keys); with master local[*] it also sets spark.driver.bindAddress=127.0.0.1 and spark.driver.host=127.0.0.1, so Spark starts on a laptop (VPN, several networks).

decisions.question: Spark settings every session sets, key=value separated by commas - e.g. spark.sql.session.timeZone=UTC, spark.sql.shuffle.partitions=200 - or none?
